Completed batch 39: two draft pages and ten local items, including marginal convergence under uniform ergodicity or containment, a local drift/minorization proof, and a strong-law counterexample that still satisfies simultaneous uniform ergodicity.

The controlling BCS-36 design requires BCS-29 and BCS-32; the task and `plan-spec.json` list only BCS-32. I added BCS-29 to the A-page requirements and recorded the discrepancy. The scheduler check now reports its shared run-level graph as stale; it remains untouched for the owner to recompute.

All ten assigned items have current `ready` Step 1 records. Scoped checks passed: proof contracts 10/10, proof layout 10 items and 41 steps with no defects, render checks for 12 files, source coverage, and both source fetch records. All ten dependency levels match; the combined batch check reports one unrelated BCS-32 level mismatch. The full-run Step 1 gate remains open at 55/763 current records. These records indicate author readiness, not independent approval.

The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-39.notes.md) document the source dispositions, supplier review, plan reconciliation, and check results. The draft pages are [A](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/adaptive-mcmc-convergence-and-limitations.md) and [B](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/bayesian-computational-statistics/adaptive-mcmc-convergence-and-limitations-examples.md).
